name: Oku-sama Uchuu
source:
The protagonist works at a liquor store, delivering booze to the customers. He is attracted to alcohol.
On the address of delivery, he meets three beautiful women.
It is the first act in a grand love attack by the beauties. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038396.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角在一家酒类商店工作，为顾客送酒。他被酒精所吸引。
在送货地址上，他遇到了三个美丽的女人。
这是美女们一场盛大的爱情攻势的第一幕。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038396.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
